elements.requirement: A person cannot, by reference to any contract term or to a notice given to persons generally or to particular persons, exclude or restrict liability for death or personal injury resulting from negligence.
elements.quote: cannot by reference to any contract term or to a notice given to persons generally or to particular persons exclude or restrict his liability for death or personal injury resulting from negligence

elements.requirement: In the case of loss or damage other than death or personal injury, a person cannot exclude or restrict liability for negligence by reference to a contract term or notice except in so far as the term or notice satisfies the requirement of reasonableness.
elements.quote: In the case of other loss or damage, a person cannot so exclude or restrict his liability for negligence except in so far as the term or notice satisfies the requirement of reasonableness

elements.requirement: Where a contract term or notice purports to exclude or restrict liability for negligence, a person's agreement to or awareness of that term or notice is not of itself to be taken as indicating that person's voluntary acceptance of any risk.
elements.quote: Where a contract term or notice purports to exclude or restrict liability for negligence a person’s agreement to or awareness of it is not of itself to be taken as indicating his voluntary acceptance of any risk

elements.requirement: The rules in section 2 of the Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977 do not apply to a term in a consumer contract or to a notice to the extent that it is a consumer notice (for which provision is made in sections 62 and 65 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015).
elements.quote: This section does not apply to— (a) a term in a consumer contract, or (b) a notice to the extent that it is a consumer notice, (but see the provision made about such contracts and notices in sections 62 and 65 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015)
